title: Bossen and Others (Case C-559/16), 7 September 2017
excerpt: the concept of ‘distance’ relates, in the case of air routes with connecting flights, only to the distance calculated between the first point of departure and the final destination on the basis of the ‘great circle’ method, regardless of the distance actually flown.
summary: For connecting flights, the distance is the great circle distance from the first departure point to the final destination, not the distance flown.
